newsitem.title: UK: British Airways drops super-747 plan - report.
newsitem.headline: British Airways drops super-747 plan - report.

text.p: British Airways Plc has shelved plans to be a launch customer for the super Jumbo jet planned by Boeing Co, the Independent newspaper reported on Monday.
The report, which did not cite sources, said the move was a blow to Boeing's hopes of proceeding with the $7 billion project for the 747-600x, a proposed family of 450-550 seater jets.

The Independent quoted Ron Woodard, president of the Boeing Commercial Airplane Group, as saying the odds of launching the plane are "a little better than 50-50, but it is not a slam dunk. We will be betting the company on this project and we have a tough business case to prove."
Late on Saturday, Boeing said Thai Airways International Ltd and Malaysian Airline System Bhd had signed up to buy the stretch jumbo jets if they were built.
